recipes.name: JERK CHICKEN
ingredients: 2 cup long grain white rice, rinsed
instructions: For the Tostones
Peel and cut the plantains into 1 inch slices. - 3 green plantains
Fill a large high-sided skillet with about ⅛ inch to ¼ inch of neutral oil. Heat until the oil begins to shimmer. - As needed neutral oil
Add the plantain slices to the oil and cook for about 1-2 minutes on each side or until just beginning to crisp. - 3 green plantains

Transfer the par-cooking plantains to a paper towel lined sheet tray. While the slices are still warm, carefully depressed them to about ½ inch thickness. Traditionally, Tostones are flattened using a Tostonera, if you don’t have one, use the bottom of a bowl, cup, or pan. - For the Tostones
Return the pressed plantains to the preheated oil and fry until golden brown and crispy on both sides, about 1-2 minutes. - For the Tostones - As needed neutral oil
Transfer the tostones to a paper towel-lined sheet tray and season generously with kosher salt. - As needed kosher salt
For the Rice and Peas
Combine the beans, water, and unsweetened coconut milk in a medium pot. - 1 can (15.5 oz) red kidney beans - 2 ¼ cup water - 1 can (13.5 oz) unsweetened coconut milk

Bring the mixture to a boil and then add the remaining ingredients. Allow the mixture to come back to a boil uncovered. - 3 scallion stems trimmed + roughly chopped - 1 whole scotch bonnet - 3 garlic cloves crushed - 2 cup long grain white rice rinsed - ½ tsp allspice berries lightly crushed - 5 sprigs thyme - As needed kosher salt
Once at a boil, reduce to a simmer and cover the pot with a lid.
Cook until the water is evaporated and the rice is cooked through, about 15-20 minutes.
Season to taste with kosher salt. Keep warm until ready to serve. - As needed kosher salt
For the Jerk Chicken
Combine the allspice berries and peppercorns in a mortar and grind with a pestle until well ground. - 1 ½ tbsp allspice berries - 1 ½ tsp black peppercorns

Add the remaining ingredients (save for the chicken) and the ground spices into the base of a food processor. Process until a homogenous mixture forms. Reserve until ready to use. - 4 ½ scotch bonnet peppers (red or orange) - 3 scallion stems chopped - 4 garlic cloves roughly chopped - 1 ½ tbsp fresh thyme leaves - 2 tsp kosher salt - ¼ cup neutral oil - 2 tbsp brown sugar - 1 tbsp soy sauce
Break down the chicken into 2 bone-in thighs, 2 wings (tips included), and 2 bone-in breast pieces. Make sure to keep the skin intact and much as possible. - 1 whole chicken

In a large sealable container, combine the chicken pieces and the reserved marinade. Make sure to rub the marinade under the skin and that all pieces of chicken have been thoroughly coated. - 1 whole chicken
Cover the container and transfer it to the refrigerator. Let the chicken marinade for at least 4 hour or up to 24 hours.
Preheat your smoker to 450°F with your choice of fruity wood (we used applewood).

Add the chicken to the smoker and cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches 145 °F, about 25-30 minutes. Flip the chicken pieces and continue cooking until the white meat reaches 155 °F and the dark meat reaches 175 °F, about 5-10 minutes. - For the Jerk Chicken
Remove the chicken from the smoker and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
